title: The client posts a JSON body
label: REQUEST
caption: The body is untyped JSON: qty arrives as the string "2".

title: The API validates it into a DTO
label: VALIDATE
caption: validateCreateOrder parses the body; qty becomes a number and the service only ever sees a CreateOrderDto.

title: The service builds an Order and inserts it
label: PERSIST
caption: OrderService builds a domain Order, which has no id until the database assigns one.

title: The database returns the row
label: STORED
caption: The insert returns the row with the id Postgres assigned.

title: The row maps back to an Order
label: MAP
caption: The service returns a domain Order, not the row: the API never sees column names.

title: The API answers 201 with a response body
label: RESPOND
caption: The API serializes the Order for the wire, exposing the id as a public string.

title: The client posts an invalid body
label: BAD REQUEST
caption: Same endpoint, but qty is "-1".

title: Validation rejects it at the API
label: REJECTED
caption: The API answers 422 naming the field. The service and the database are never called.
